notes.title: Introducing the N-37 HS "Heatsink"
notes.notes:
Attention, Airmen!

Civilian safe zones are falling. Our outposts are outgunned. And HQ’s last intel drop points to a shift in the enemy’s behavior: faster, stronger, relentless. We needed a weapon that wouldn't cool down when the world was heating up.

The N-37 HS “Heatsink” prototype weapon was built for this moment. This weapon doesn’t cool off like standard armaments. Every time it overheats, it builds pressure, residual thermal energy stored deep within the chamber. One overheat, it climbs to 30%. A second, 60%. After the third, it vents and resets. 

Operators report up to 200% damage output at full thermal capacity. Every single percent of stored heat adds one percent more impact. The MK3 refinement pushes this even further, allowing damage to scale with heat up to a staggering 3X. Past the 30% mark, each shot scorches the ground on impact, igniting a 1.2m radius with 120% fire damage over a full second. Push it to 60%, and every seventh round unleashes a trio of flame tornados, dealing burst damage every 0.2 seconds while dragging zombies straight into the inferno. With the MK6 refinement, these tornados are unleashed more frequently, requiring one less shot to activate.

The Heatsink is not just another autocannon. It’s a pressure-fed firestorm machine. Flames, tornados, pressure surges, you're not firing bullets. You're detonating bottled hell.

The N-37 HS “Heatsink” is now operational. Earn it in blood. Be among the top 25 at season’s end to take it home.

notes.title: League System
notes.notes:
Attention Airmen,

Our battlefield is evolving, presenting new challenges and demanding greater resilience from each of us. To meet these challenges head-on, we're proud to introduce an innovative [b]League System that brings fair competition to all players[/b]!

[b]The League System in a Nutshell[/b]

Picture ZGS’s League system as a rigorous training regimen where every Airman is called upon to demonstrate their mettle on the battlefield. Just as in the military, we are organized into Divisions, each exemplifying a distinct level of performance and combat readiness. Your performance in weekly leaderboard events will serve as your battlefield merit, determining your ascent through these divisions. 

The League System operates on a seasonal basis, spanning four weeks, with each week hosting a leaderboard event. Engage in these events to not only earn regular leaderboard rewards but also seize the opportunity[b] for additional seasonal rewards at the end of the season[/b]!

[b]Understanding Divisions and PWR Rating[/b]

[u]Divisions and PWR Rating[/u]

Our divisions, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Elite, and Legend, symbolize the hierarchy of combat performance. Within each division, there are three subdivisions, providing a clear path for advancement.

Your PWR Rating, or Power Rating, is your measure of effectiveness within these divisions, determined by your performance and the number of runs in leaderboard events.

Each division has access to a different event difficulty with a higher Max score. The Target Score is a percentage of this Max Score, changing with each division. If you score below the Target, you lose PWR points; exceed it, and you gain. The points gained or lost depend on how much you surpass or fall short of the Target Score. 

[b]Let’s clarify:[/b] Your PWR rating reflects your performance, firepower, and commitment to engagement.

[b]The Spread of Players and Dynamic Competition when Leagues first start[/b]

We place you initially based on your player rank, ensuring a fair spread across the divisions. But remember, your division placement isn't static. Through your engagement and performance in leaderboard events, you can rise or fall within your division, keeping the competition dynamic and fair for all:

[u]Placement based on player rank:[/u]

Rank/Division

2/B3
3-4/B2
5-7/B1
8-11/S3
12-15/S2
16-20/S1
21-25/G3
26-29/G2
30/G1

[b]The Heart of the Action[/b]

[u]Localized Competition[/u]

Gone are the days of broad, impersonal competition. Now, you'll compete within a smaller, more focused group. This league-based segmentation limits each group to a maximum of 50 players, including yourself, creating a more personal and achievable competition that encourages camaraderie and healthy rivalries.

[u]Weekly Leaderboard Events[/u]

Each week, you'll compete in leaderboard events, where your performance directly impacts your PWR rating. Real-time updates keep you informed about your progress, ensuring that every move counts toward your advancement.

[u]The boosters will turn into Resource Multiplier[/u]

Boosters will transform into resource multipliers, amplifying rewards like metal supplies, parts, and gold after each run. This will foster more strategic gameplay and fair competition. The multiplier will apply only to seasonal league events. 

[u]Demotion: Keeping the Stakes High[/u]

To maintain the competitive spirit, players must remain active. Not participating in an event (0 runs) will result in a PWR penalty, ensuring that only the most dedicated Airmen rise to the top.

[b]Rewards: A Testament to Valor[/b]

[u]Seasonal Rewards[/u]

As you ascend through the divisions, your rewards grow in value, recognizing your commitment and skill. Keep an eye on the Divisions Overview screen to see the divisions/subdivisions with the PWR rating thresholds needed to promote, the seasonal rewards for the 5 tiers, and a Top 25 best players.

[u]Top 25 Players[/u]

The top 25 roster stands as the benchmark of excellence, showcasing the legendary Airmen who have transcended the ordinary ranks. Upon ascending to the esteemed Legend 1 division, these Airmen gain the capability to accumulate unlimited PWR, marking the commencement of a relentless struggle for supremacy. They battle to maintain their dominance at the pinnacle of the hierarchy and to[b]receive exclusive prototype weapons[/b].

[u]Weekly Leaderboard Rewards[/u]

Your dedication to weekly leaderboard events does not go unnoticed. Based on your standing, you will be duly rewarded. As you advance through the divisions, expect missions to escalate in difficulty, but rest assured, the rewards will match the challenge, growing more substantial with each triumph.

[b]Enhancements to Playerbase UI[/b]

We've updated the user interface to better reflect your progress and standing. Your PWR rating and current division now proudly sit alongside your player rank, giving you a clear view of your battlefield performance.

[b]Season Reset: A Chance for Redemption[/b]

At the end of each season, there's a reset that brings you back two subdivisions – a chance for a fresh start. Your former glory isn't forgotten; instead, it's factored into your new baseline, ensuring that your past achievements continue to inspire your future endeavors.

[b]Dev Q&A Session[/b]

We would like to invite you to share your feedback during the DEV Q&A session to help improve the League system. Additionally, we encourage you to delve into the League system once it's released, as experiencing it firsthand may provide clarity and inspire more precise questions. 
Join our Discord community to participate in the Q&A Session: https://discord.com/invite/BthCgFdaBA
Our team will return with answers, but not all at once, as it will take some time to process all your questions. We appreciate your patience.

Get ready, Airmen, to battle zombies and make your mark on the battlefield! Let your valor shine as you advance through the divisions and carve your legacy on the battlefield!

notes.title: Easter's Special Event "Final Hour"
notes.notes:
Attention Airmen,

Prepare for the ultimate test of survival in our latest event, "Final Hour". A new era of terror unfolds with the "monstrosity" event type, a new resurgence event, bringing forth the mightiest zombie tyrant. This colossal challenge demands your best tactics, precision, and resilience. Are you ready to face the apocalypse's final hour?"

Event Highlights:

Wave Count: Survive through 30 intense waves of undead assault.
Power Surge: With each wave, zombies grow stronger.
Invisible Threat: Beware of the Spectre, a zombie that eludes the AC-130, healing its brethren amidst the chaos.

Primeval Scourge: 

From the very first wave, face the Primeval Scourge, an undying shambler that evolves throughout the event, spawning various deadly forms:

Obscuring Impalers: Their demise clouds your vision with smoke.
Resilient Wreckers: Briefly freezes in place while becoming immune to damage every few seconds.
Strider: A colossal adversary, slow but nearly indestructible.
Hive: A source of endless Ravenous Shamblers, until destroyed.
Obscuring Pillar: Its smoke clouds hinder your sight.
Hysteria Pillar: Speeds up the zombie horde, enhancing their onslaught.
Smoke Explosion: Devastates your base with a lethal smoke burst.

The Final Stand: 

At wave 26, the Primeval Scourge makes its last reincarnation, losing its powers but gaining healing abilities, finally becoming vulnerable to your firepower.

Score Breakdown:

Type | Points | Amount Spawned | Total

Spectre | 100 | 60 | 6000
Strider | 200 | 10 | 2000
Primeval Scourge 1000 | 1 | 1000

This event is not for the faint-hearted. Sharpen your skills, load up your AC-130, and prepare to rain destruction upon the undead. The final hour is upon us, and only the strongest will survive the Monstrosity Resurgence.

Do you have what it takes to conquer the apocalypse's ultimate challenge?

Good luck, Airmen!

Attention Airmen!

In the relentless skies of our post-apocalyptic world, where the undead swarm the earth in numbers beyond reckoning, the need for superior firepower has never been more critical. We are thrilled to unveil the next evolution in aerial warfare technology: Orion, the first of its kind in the new "Intelligent" weapon class.

Orion isn't just a weapon - it's a revolution. With its state-of-the-art auto-tracking system, Orion locks onto targets with unmatched precision, marking up to 10 zombies within its lethal embrace. Each target is tagged with a red crosshair, awaiting your command to unleash devastation. When you release the firing button, Orion delivers a bullet to each marked target, ensuring not a single shot is wasted.

Features:

Intelligent Targeting: 
Automatically locks on and intermittently paralyzes targets, ensuring your enemies are not just hit, but halted.

Enhanced Efficiency: 
Kills with Orion not only clear the field but boost its power and efficiency.

Legendary Power: 
At legendary status, Orion's killing and paralysis potential reaches new heights, becoming the ultimate tool in your aerial arsenal.

Aural Immersion: 
Experience the battlefield like never before with unique sounds for aiming, firing, and reloading phases, designed to immerse you fully in the action.

Freezing Firepower: 
Every fourth shot damages and freezes targets in a small area. Achieve legendary status, and this chilling ability triggers on every third shot, laying waste to zombie hordes with icy precision.

Power Progression: 
Targeting capabilities that improve with each upgrade star.

Welcome to the future of zombie warfare. Welcome to Orion.
